message.content: {"results":[{"n":"G1","evidence":"All five screenshots show the 3D bamboo scene rendering properly in Chrome without blank screens or visible errors.","pass":true},{"n":"G2","evidence":"OrbitControls allows orbiting, but there is no maxPolarAngle limit to prevent going below ground, and controls.maxDistance = 45 allows zooming completely outside the grove into empty white fog as seen in screenshot 5.","pass":false},{"n":"G3","evidence":"The scene uses only two InstancedMeshes (340 stalks and 3400 leaf planes), one 2048x2048 shadow map, and a lightweight UnrealBloomPass, which will easily run above 30 fps on a standard laptop.","pass":true},{"n":"1","evidence":"All screenshots display a persistent UI bar at the bottom left containing instructional text and three interactive buttons ('Match Photo Angle', 'Ground Walk View', 'Wind: ON').","pass":false},{"n":"2","evidence":"In the code, windOn defaults to true and animate() updates windUniforms.uTime every frame, driving vertex shader wind sway on both bamboo stalks and leaves on load.","pass":true},{"n":"3","evidence":"Screenshot 1 matches the steep upward-looking wide-angle perspective of the reference photo, including converging foreground stalks and an overhanging dark tree branch in the upper left.","pass":true},{"n":"4","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show dense foreground and mid-ground bamboo spacing comparable to the reference photo.","pass":true},{"n":"5","evidence":"The palette in screenshot 1 is heavily washed out by white bloom/haze and lacks the rich yellow-green canopy and deep blue-green/teal shadows on the stalks seen in the reference photo.","pass":false},{"n":"6","evidence":"Neither the reference photo nor the 3D scene contains a path or brushwood fence; the code only places a plain dark green CircleGeometry at y = -0.35.","pass":false},{"n":"7","evidence":"Like the reference photo, screenshot 1 features bright overhead sky illumination filtering down through the canopy toward the camera, though with excessive bloom.","pass":true},{"n":"8","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 clearly show regular dark horizontal node rings with slight geometric bulges along every bamboo stalk.","pass":true},{"n":"9","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 and the instance scaling code (scaleR from 0.68 to 1.23, scaleY from 0.82 to 1.14) show varied stalk thicknesses and heights.","pass":true},{"n":"10","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show stalks leaning at varied angles rather than standing in a uniform vertical grid.","pass":true},{"n":"11","evidence":"Screenshot 4 clearly shows the canopy composed of clusters of thin, narrow lanceolate leaves arranged in fan sprays.","pass":true},{"n":"12","evidence":"In section 9 of the code, the ground is just a flat, untextured CircleGeometry with a solid color (0x1a2616), with no soil texture or fallen leaves.","pass":false},{"n":"13","evidence":"Screenshot 5 shows the entire bamboo grove ending abruptly as an isolated circular patch floating in white space when zoomed out.","pass":false},{"n":"14","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show uniform blown-out white specular highlights along the stalks rather than dappled sunlight patches, and leafInstanced has castShadow = false by default so leaves cast no shadows.","pass":false},{"n":"15","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show bright atmospheric haze and bloom between the stalks that create a sense of depth looking upward.","pass":true},{"n":"16","evidence":"In screenshots 1 and 4, leaves have a flat, opaque green appearance from uniform emissive coloring rather than realistic backlit light transmission.","pass":false},{"n":"17","evidence":"In screenshots 1–4, shadowed areas on and between the stalks remain dark green and are never pure black.","pass":true},{"n":"18","evidence":"While stalks have a glossy sheen in screenshots 1–3, they all share the exact same repeating procedural canvas texture with uniform green coloration, lacking natural yellowing or distinct stains.","pass":false},{"n":"19","evidence":"Screenshot 4 shows the leaf planes up close as completely opaque cutout cards with flat gradients rather than translucent foliage.","pass":false},{"n":"20","evidence":"The ground is not visible in screenshots 1–4 and in code (section 9) is simply a solid-colored MeshStandardMaterial(0x1a2616) circle with no texture or detail.","pass":false},{"n":"21","evidence":"The camera looks steeply upward to match the photo's converging verticals without any unintended camera roll or horizon tilt (camera.up is default Y-up).","pass":true},{"n":"22","evidence":"The vertex shader in leafMat.onBeforeCompile applies continuous sine-wave canopySway and flutter displacements driven by uTime.","pass":true},{"n":"23","evidence":"In bambooMat.onBeforeCompile, horizontal wind displacement is multiplied by pow(hFactor, 2.1), so the base stays fixed while bending increases quadratically toward the top.","pass":true},{"n":"24","evidence":"In bambooMat and leafMat vertex shaders, wind motion is driven purely by fixed-amplitude sine/cosine waves of uTime with uWindStrength held constant at 1.0, producing uniform oscillation rather than varied gusts.","pass":false},{"n":"25","evidence":"Neither the screenshots nor the HTML source code contain any particle systems, falling leaves, or drifting dust.","pass":false},{"n":"26","evidence":"In animate(), uTime advances continuously via clock.getElapsedTime() without resets, and frequencies (0.72 to 2.4 rad/s) with modest amplitudes (0.14 to 0.32m) produce smooth real-world sway speeds without jumps.","pass":true},{"n":"27","evidence":"All 340 stalks instantiate a single geometry (bambooGeo) with a hardcoded 0.65m bow along +X and the exact same repeating texture, resulting in visibly identical node patterns on adjacent stalks in screenshots 1–3.","pass":false},{"n":"28","evidence":"The code uses no LOD switching, frustum-culled sub-chunks, or alpha-blended sorting (leaves use alphaTest: 0.32), avoiding pop-in or transparency flicker while orbiting.","pass":true},{"n":"29","evidence":"In screenshots 1–4, random leaf cluster placement within a 1.6–2.8m spread around stalk anchors causes numerous leaf planes to intersect and clip directly through nearby bamboo stalks.","pass":false},{"n":"30","evidence":"Screenshot 1 immediately reads as stylized real-time 3D graphics due to blown-out white specular stripes on the stalks, blocky untextured tree branches on the left, flat cutout leaves, and an on-screen UI bar.","pass":false}]}
